title: Can biking activity be a signal of displacement risk?
gallery_text: Runners have often been perceived as an early sign of gentrification. In Boston, biking activity varies significantly across neighborhoods, shaped by geography, infrastructure, and patterns of movement through the city. This project explores a possible relationship between biking activity and displacement: do neighborhoods with less biking activity experience displacement more slowly?
